t: This is the Aldwych Theatre, a West End theatre on the Aldwych in the City of Westminster. It was listed Grade II on the twentieth of July 1971, and it holds twelve hundred people on three levels. The architect was W. G. R. Sprague, who trained under Frank Matcham and then set up his own practice. Between 1890 and 1929 he designed at least thirty-five theatres. Eleven of his surviving London theatres are listed as buildings of special architectural or historic interest, and this is one of them.
